vm-000004 hosts container-000004 which is routed to by lb-000003; vm transitioned to stopped state at sequence 37 (~1.1ms before alert); container-000004 now in restarting state with 3 restarts, unable to reliably serve traffic

sg-000002 attached to vm-000004 which hosts container-000004; open_to_world changed false→true at sequence 41 (~0.6ms before alert); security rule changes can cause connectivity disruptions and increase latency

report.narrative: Multiple correlated failures in the alert window: container-000008 exited (sequence 24, ~3ms pre-alert), reducing available targets; vm-000004 stopped (sequence 37, ~1ms pre-alert), causing container-000004 to restart repeatedly; sg-000002 security rule opened to world (sequence 41, ~0.6ms pre-alert). All three target significant load concentration on the single healthy target (vm-000002), explaining the latency spike. The lb itself shows draining state with only 1 healthy target remaining of 3.
